---
title: "Publication Policy"
---

## Evidence and reproducibility

Published articles distinguish **source-reported model characteristics**, **experimental observations**, and **interpretations or hypotheses**. Unless expressly stated otherwise, results involving proprietary cohorts cannot be independently reproduced from this website.

Published charts are visualizations of reported aggregate metrics. They do not imply access to, or release of, underlying private data.

## Data, source code, and rights

Private queries, candidate content, project identifiers, repository metadata, checkpoints, internal logs, and confidential materials are not published. Code associated with a study may be made available separately only after an ownership and disclosure review.

Publication does not imply authorization to reuse third-party materials or that the research represents an employer or institution.

## Corrections

Factual corrections and technical questions can be raised via GitHub Issues. Any future GitHub Discussions space, if enabled, is for discussion; it does not imply public collaborative access to private experimental artifacts.
